risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Frequent changes in telecom regulations, licensing frameworks, Right of Way policies, spectrum-related regulations and compliance requirements may impact project execution timelines, operating costs and profitability.
- Dependence on a limited number of large telecom operators, infrastructure customers or enterprise clients; industry consolidation among telecom operators may affect infrastructure demand and customer relationships.
- Intense competition from telecom operators, infrastructure providers, broadband service providers and emerging technology companies may pressure market share, pricing and margins.
- Rapid technology changes require continuous infrastructure upgrades and investment; increasing dependence on digital systems exposes the business to cybersecurity and data-protection risks.
- Changes in interest rates, inflationary pressures and availability of capital may impact future investments and profitability; delays in customer payments may affect working capital and cash flows.
- Delays in approvals, site acquisition, Right of Way permissions, supply chain disruptions and unforeseen execution hurdles may impact project timelines and operational performance.
